title: Head-Nod Phone Screen for Elders with Shaking Hands
title_te: చేతులు వణికే పెద్దల కోసం తల ఊపితే పనిచేసే ఫోన్ స్క్రీన్
problem: My grandfather's hands shake a lot, so whenever he tries to tap a phone screen to answer calls, he accidentally presses the wrong button or hangs up.
idea: A head-move phone helper. Grandpa just tilts his head up to answer and turns it to the side to cut the call. Here you can tap the head move the camera 'sees'.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What did grandpa's head do?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Scratch face tracking watches grandpa's head. Here, tap a move.
widgets.question: The phone is ringing. Grandpa's head:

options.label: Stays still
options.result: Waiting... the phone is still ringing.

options.label: Face not seen
options.result: I can't see your face. Please look at the phone.
options.te: మీ ముఖం కనిపించడం లేదు. ఫోన్ వైపు చూడండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Make Grandpa's Phone Easy
widgets.intro: Tick the phone settings you have already set up for grandpa.

items.text: Big font and big display size turned on
Phone kept in a stand so it doesn't fall
Speaker phone used so he need not hold it

bands.text: Perfect! Grandpa's phone is very easy now.
Good! Set up the rest too.
Let's set up the phone together this weekend.

how: Open Scratch and add the Face Sensing extension (or use PictoBlox face detection).
Use the 'head tilt' or face position block to check if grandpa's head moves up.
When it tilts up, show a big green ANSWER button and play a sound.
Design extra-large green and red buttons in Canva and upload them as Scratch costumes.
Test the moves with grandpa and make the tilt amount easy for him.
Ask Gemini for other phone settings that help elders with shaking hands.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. My grandfather's hands shake and he can't tap the phone well. Give me 6 simple phone settings and tips in English and Telugu that make it easier for him to answer calls.
